title: Cokret Minimal-Metadata Identity Link
description: Encrypted application-message or MLS private-extension payload that binds a Realm-scoped pairwise DID to the real principal DID for ck.profile.mls.minimal_metadata_realm.v1. The binding is scoped to both realm_id and trust_domain so the same pairwise mapping cannot be replayed across deployments. This object is never written to public Realm history unless a separate disclosure policy explicitly permits it.

pairwise_did.description: Realm-scoped pairwise DID used in Event.actor_id and MLS leaf credential. The v1 boundary is the Realm, not a Matrix-style Room.

principal_id.description: Real principal DID that controls or has disclosed the pairwise DID.

trust_domain.description: Deployment-scope trust domain. Receiver MUST require this value to match the current Realm / service trust_domain before accepting a pairwise DID -> principal DID mapping.

flow_id.description: Optional Flow scope marker. Present when the pairwise mapping is materialised within a Flow-scoped MLS subgroup (per flow-and-message.md §4 + crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.4). When present, the receiver MUST verify the Flow lives in realm_id.

track_name.description: Optional Flow track context marker. Required (via allOf conditional) when flow_id is present so the identity link can be narrowed to a concrete Flow track context. Track does not carry independent membership; if the discussion side needs its own membership / history visibility / E2EE boundary, the whole Flow MUST use Flow.scope_circle_id to bind a Circle, or the design MUST split into two Flows linked by confidential_discussion_of. Aligned with Flow.tracks propertyNames (schemas/flow.schema.json #/$defs/track_name).

mls_group_id.description: Optional MLS group identifier (base64url RFC 9420 GroupID) for diagnostic / cross-implementation correlation. NOT used by the reducer for authorization — authoritative MLS group state lives in ck.mls.genesis / ck.mls.commit events. Provided here so audit projections can quickly correlate an identity-link with its MLS group without replaying the full epoch chain.

verification_method.description: DID URL of a key controlled by principal_id or by a disclosure proof accepted by Realm policy. Fragment is REQUIRED (this is a DID URL, not a bare DID). DID method-name normalized to lowercase per W3C DID 1.0.

payload_digest.description: Hash of canonical input bytes: utf8('cx-identity-link-v1\n') || canonical_json(identity-link object with proof.signature omitted). The signed object includes trust_domain.
